description: The line plot, titled “ReDial,” illustrates the performance of two metrics—Recall@50 and NDCG@50—for two methods: “Ours” and “ReFICR”—across five discrete values on the x-axis, likely representing experimental conditions or model iterations. The left y-axis, labeled “Recall@50,” ranges from 0.30 to 0.60 with tick marks at 0.05 intervals and is used for the green and blue solid lines. The right y-axis, labeled “NDCG@50,” ranges from 0.15 to 0.22 with tick marks at 0.01 intervals and is used for the green and blue dotted lines. The green solid line, labeled “Recall@50 (Ours),” starts at approximately 0.35 when x=1 and increases steadily to about 0.49 at x=5. The blue solid line, “NDCG@50 (Ours),” begins at approximately 0.16 at x=1 and rises to about 0.185 at x=5. The green dotted line, “NDCG@50 (Ours),” remains nearly flat across all x-values, hovering around 0.19. The blue dotted line, “NDCG@50 (ReFICR),” is also nearly flat, staying constant at approximately 0.15 across all x-values. All lines are marked with circular or square markers at each integer x-value from 1 to 5.
